ValidationRule.description: If not a UAE Resident, then Passport Expiry Date field is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(UAEResidentStatus__c) = 'Non-Resident', ISBLANK(PassportExpiryDate__c), IsConverted, ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Self Generated"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, "Modon - Egypt")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Passport Expiry Date field is mandatory if the Lead is not a UAE Resident
